Name: TID_CHARACTER_CLASS_DESCRIPTION_0
Text: Bodyguards are extremely durable and fierce melee fighters. The Bodyguard taunts all enemies to attack him, allowing the rest of the group to work in peace.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_CLASS_DESCRIPTION_1
Text: Everyone loves a Doctor for his ability to heal all wounds. The Doctor keeps the rest of the group going, and because of this he will always find a lot of friends.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_CLASS_DESCRIPTION_2
Text: Hunters prefer to stay back and deal massive damage with all firearms. They can also knock down and slow enemies, making them useful in all situations.
